_2026-10-18 23:00 → 2026-10-19 23:00 UTC_

[ERC-8004 forum reply](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/425)

> **Transformer study notes submitted as a shared knowledge resource** — A comprehensive zero-to-complete walkthrough of Transformer internals was opened as a pull request for the group's knowledge base. [PR #14](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/pull/14)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### guarantee-composition
_The guarantee-composition work advanced through coverage gap confirmation, a structured new contribution, and the initiation of an independent cold review cycle._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) confirmed that two distinct missing obligations uncovered by independent replay are valid coverage gaps, sharpening the research problem definition and anchoring the next phase of work. [tg:tawg:5601]
- Baby Blue Viper submitted draft PR #5 against the v4 branch with all new work under v4_1 and no modifications to original files, providing a clean and reviewable separation that protects the existing evidence base. [tg:tawg:5603]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) acknowledged the clean separation in PR #5 and confirmed that an independent cold review is being prepared, including O14 witnesses and authorization checks, keeping the review process rigorous and self-contained. [tg:tawg:5604]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) outlined that completing review of PRs #5 and #6 would produce a Claim-Aware Verification Engine — a more substantial shared output than individual verification experiments. [tg:tawg:5605]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) described how the same completion milestone would provide an experimental foundation for tracking how guarantees survive end-to-end across the Trustless AI stack. [tg:tawg:5607]

### ERC-8004
_The rater–agent pair counting question moved from open forum discussion to confirmed grounded implementation._

- A forum exchange on EF Magicians confirmed that the (rater, agent) pair counting approach works and is now captured in the grounded implementation, settling an open design question for ERC-8004 rating. [ERC-8004 forum reply](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/425)
- Baby Blue Viper confirmed the rater–agent pair binding is already present in the `/1` implementation at a specific referenced commit, showing the design decision had already been encoded in working code. [ERC-8004 forum reply](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/426)

### transformer-notes
_The group's shared knowledge base gained a detailed Transformer architecture reference that moved through discussion and into formal review._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) shared in-depth study notes covering the Transformer architecture from tokenization through attention mechanics, the KV cache, and backpropagation, giving the group an accessible technical foundation for understanding modern AI model internals. [tg:tawg:5609]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) incorporated technical corrections and acknowledged their value for accuracy, advancing the study notes toward a reliable shared reference document. [tg:tawg:5615]

### community
_The group's network expanded with a new connection at the intersection of attestation and agent security._

- Merlini (@gobross) welcomed Lucas, founder of Fidacy, and highlighted the group's shared interest in attestation, agents, and security, broadening the community engaged with Trustless AI research. [tg:tawg:5614]
